req.title: Task deletion persists
req.statement: The system shall remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404 for that id.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[4] having kind=negative but heuristic=STC. STC (State Transition Coverage) is a structural/positive heuristic that traces valid state paths; it must not be paired with kind=negative. The fix is to change that test's kind to 'positive', which correctly reflects that STC traces the happy-path state machine: task exists -> deleted -> confirmed absent. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were. Tests: (1) positive/EP - delete existing task, verify 204 then GET 404; (2) negative/NEG - delete non-existent task, verify 404; (3) boundary/BVA - delete lowest id boundary; (4) boundary/BVA - delete highest id boundary; (5) positive/STC - state transition coverage: exists->deleted->absent; (6) positive/DT - double-delete idempotency.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404
preconditions: Database contains task with id=5 (title='Write project report', completed=false)
FastAPI app is running in-process with TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a known task and capture its id
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 with the created task
DELETE returns HTTP 204 with no body
trace: R-TASK-023: deleted rows must be removed so subsequent GET returns 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Write project report", "description": None, "completed": False})
assert r_create.status_code == 201
task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
r_delete = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
assert r_delete.status_code == 204
assert r_delete.content == b""
r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
assert r_get.status_code == 404

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
